competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Respond effectively to difficult/challenging behavior: nagpaplano ang BHW ng tugong may pahintulot at bukas na tanong, nakikinig nang mahinahon at ibinubuod ang alalahanin nang walang panghuhusga, nakikipagkasundo sa makatotohanang susunod na hakbang na may responsable at oras ng follow-up, at gumagawa ng factual na handover sa awtorisadong katrabaho at pumipili ng isang tiyak na pagpapabuti sa sariling tugon.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Respond effectively to difficult/challenging behavior: the BHW plans a response with permission and an open question, listens calmly and summarizes the concern without judgment, agrees a realistic next step with a responsible person and follow-up time, and makes a factual handover to an authorized colleague while choosing one specific improvement to their own response.
